title: Romance emergency money
plain_description: An online friend asks for emergency money after building trust.
scammer_goal: Get money through a emotional emergency story.
opening_message: My love, I am stuck abroad. Please send money today through crypto. Do not tell your family.

easy.opening_message: Send Bitcoin now or I will lose my chance to visit you. Keep this secret.

hard.opening_message: I feel terrible asking. There is a sudden hospital bill. Crypto is the only way I can receive help today.
